profile.description: Americana Restaurants International PLC operates a chain of restaurant in the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Egypt, Qatar, Kazakhstan, Bahrain, Jordan, Oman, Lebanon, Morocco, and Iraq. It operates quick service, fast casual, indulgence, casual dining, and coffee restaurants across the dine-in, take-away, drive-thru, car-hop, and home delivery channels. The company was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Sharjah, the United Arab Emirates. Americana Restaurants International PLC is a subsidiary of Adeptio AD Investments Ltd.

summary: Americana Restaurants reported record H1 2026 results with revenue up 12.1% to $1.36B and net profit surging 59.2% to $147.2M on strong same-store sales.
EBITDA rose 26.7% to $348.2M with margin expansion of 300 basis points, driven by lower inventory costs and operational discipline across markets.
Company expects mid-single digit like-for-like sales growth for full-year 2026 and targets 120-130 net new restaurant openings with visible pipeline.
Management guided to net profit margin expansion of 100-150 basis points for 2026 despite potential H2 pressure from higher-cost inventory.
Americana secured five-year ADNOC partnership for preferential access to 200 high-traffic locations and is expanding Malak Al Tawouk brand regionally.
